subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, with selective reply routing handled by existing routing policy or a separate follow-up?
rationale: The source-confirmed gap is narrow, but prompt-driven channel-selective replies would affect channel delivery policy and plugin/channel contracts.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Track channel-selective replies as a separate maintainer-approved API or routing-policy follow-up.

options.title: Document Existing Routing Policy
options.body: Close the broader selective-routing part if maintainers decide model-selected delivery channels are not planned.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the shared command prompt bundle and already gave the clearest issue-scope guidance.
